convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <scratch.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (per-frame sha256 identical).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; the Gate-1 states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is looser and not the loop standard); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, Chromium 145.0.7632.6 (playwright 1.58.0), deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport 1280x900, animations frozen, fonts ready, pointer parked, double-shot self-consistency gate byte-identical per state. CRITICAL RIG FACT (promote to environment facts): Linux headless Chromium renders LCD subpixel AA by default — the prototype's -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased is macOS-only — so targets MUST be rendered with --disable-lcd-text for grayscale-AA parity with the pen rasterizer; without it, glyph color fringing alone pushed 200x36 closed-state frames to 1.3-1.9% (frame-area-inverse sensitivity). Heebo served to the render from the same TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf) via a local @font-face, network blocked.
convergence.captureGeometry: Closed states: frame = contract root #uiDp1 (200x36). Open states: frame = root ∪ popover overflow (252x288 — 36 trigger + 4 gap + 248 popover), matching the states.json declared land-stage obligation that the story wrapper enclose the open popover.
convergence.iterationNotes: It1: authored from the normalized render's measured geometry (element rects + Range text boxes), text at em-box positions, lineHeight solid — 0.97-4.06%, label text dominating. It2: measured vertical deltas (trigger label +1px css — its 21px line box centers differently than pen's solid-line-height model; month label +0.5px) + string-level letterSpacing from ink-width deltas — closed states 1.6-1.9%. It3: long strings split into one text node per word at browser-measured word boxes (pen lays Heebo advances out with per-glyph rounding that drifts from Chromium's fractional advances, string-dependent and in BOTH directions: 'Select' +2px, 'September' -2.5px) — 0.70-1.76%. It4: per-word letterSpacing compensation = inkDelta/(glyphs-1), e.g. 'Select' -0.4, 'September' +0.3125 — 0.55-1.33%, one state still failing; diff inspection then exposed the LCD-subpixel-AA rig artifact (capture-protocol fix, not an authoring change), and it4 against corrected grayscale targets measures 0.052-0.243%, all six states PASS. It5: simplification probe dropping the letterSpacing compensations — all states still pass (0.23-0.97%) but strictly worse everywhere, so the it4 artifact stands as final (GC-001 probe-and-keep-best precedent).
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: 29/29 assertions against the normalized render, carried verbatim into the frames: frame ids = state ids (order, verbatim); V-10 popover 252w / top 40 rel trigger / 7 cols x 31.1406; V-11 trigger 36x200 ref, day 13px on 27px cell, weekday 10px/600, month 14px/600, nav 26x26; R5 fixed 42-cell matrix both months; V-1 Aug 2026 6/31/5 first '26' last '5'; V-2 Sep 2026 2/30/10 first '30' last '10'; R8 exactly one .sel pill (Aug 15, in-month); R13 focus ring on grid cell 0 (July '26', .oth); R15 label 'August 15, 2026'; R3 placeholder 'Select a date…'; R4 popover radius 6; R2 trigger radius 4.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: primary ink (--tk-text-1: committed trigger label, month label, in-month day numbers)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Near-black control ink; sem-text-header (gray-900 #0E0E0E) is the primary-text role and nearest value. sem-text-body (#403D3A warm gray) is body-copy, reads distinctly lighter — rejected.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: secondary glyphs (--tk-text-2: chevron-down svg, nav ‹ › glyphs)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Secondary glyph ink; text token chosen because the prototype consumes it via color/currentColor on text-like nodes. sem-icons-meta resolves identically in BOTH modes, so the icon-vs-text role question is moot at paint level.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: muted tertiary ink (--tk-text-3: placeholder label, weekday header, out-of-month days)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: One prototype variable serves three muted surfaces; the placeholder ROLE anchors it (R3 names it explicitly) and gray-500 #716E6A is the nearest step. sem-text-subtle (gray-400) too light for the weekday-header contrast — rejected.
Exact primitive match (taupe-350) — the design system's warm chrome border role; no input-specific border token exists in the library.
Default-border role; token value shifts the hairline to gray-100 #EEEDEB.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: trigger border hover (--tk-border-strong; renders in NO contracted frame — hover is pointer-fine CSS, pointer parked)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Role-first: the named hover-border role (gray-400 #8A8680) wins over the value-nearest sem-borders-muted; land-stage hover tests inherit the token, not Bill's hex.

Hemlock's a11y contract names sem-borders-focus as THE focus ring; role-first binding turns the ring near-black (#0E0E0E light). Deliberate divergence from the prototype's accent-blue ring — the identical call GC-001 recorded for its legend focus ring.
Selected-state action surface; exact value matches in light, and both tokens carry coordinated dark values (blue-500 fill / near-black text).

shadow-md's y/blur match exactly; color alpha reconciles 12% -> 10.2% (#0000001A). NAMING DRIFT FLAG: hemlock-design-system.md declares shadow colors carry no prefix ('shadow-md-color'), but hemlock-library.lib.pen names them prim-shadow-md-color (themed, so semantic in nature; the library's own components bind them directly). Bound the library reality; not improvised around.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: frame backdrop (region around trigger/popover inside the capture clip)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Exact value match to the page-canvas role (taupe-100); the floating popover reads against the app canvas, which is what the demo band deliberately mimics.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: hand-rolled custom date picker (shared dropdown-chrome trigger + custom calendar popover)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: hemlock-library HAS a DatePicker component family, but it is a different design (label/helper chrome, its own trigger and calendar) that cannot reproduce the executable spec's geometry (200px trigger on 36px dropdown chrome, 252px popover, fixed 42-cell matrix). Under the two-oracle split the .pen is the pixel oracle OF THIS prototype; composing the library component would fail every compare. Divergence is designer-visible here, not silently resolved — same call GC-001 recorded for DonutChart.
